units: change in ln(electricity per person) per 1.0 change in urban share (fraction), truncated at 0
source: Liddle 2013 (Environmental Modelling & Software 40:255-266, Table 6); Shahbaz et al. 2016 (Energy Economics 55:52-68, Table 5); Holtedahl & Joutz 2004 (Energy Economics 26:201-224)
evidence: Residential electricity elasticity to urbanisation 1.02 (s.e. 0.13) in the low-income panel incl. India, 0.10 in the middle-income panel (Liddle 2013); India total energy elasticity 0.56-0.80 (Shahbaz et al. 2016), i.e. gamma 1.3-1.9 at a mean urban share of 0.43; residential gamma 3.3-3.9 for Taiwan (Holtedahl & Joutz 2004). Residential use is about a quarter of India's electricity, so the total-electricity gamma is centred at 1.0 with s.d. 0.5 (about 0 to 2 at 95%).
